schemes.description: PM-KISAN is a central government scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families across India. The amount is transferred in three equal installments directly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries to supplement financial needs for agricultural inputs.

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into Aadhaar-linked bank account
additional_benefits: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) linkage available
No repayment required : it is a grant, not a loan

who_can_apply: All land-holding farmer families (husband, wife, and minor children) with cultivable land
Farmers in all states and UTs of India
exclusions: Institutional landholders
Former/current constitutional post holders
Current/retired Government employees
Income taxpayers
Professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers)
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: No specific age restriction; the family is the unit

application_mode.online: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → Farmers Corner → New Farmer Registration
application_mode.offline: Visit nearest CSC or the local Patwari/Revenue Officer

common_rejection_reasons: Incomplete e-KYC
Bank account mismatch or not Aadhaar seeded
Land record mismatch
Duplicate registration

faq.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, Aadhaar verification and seeding with the bank account is mandatory.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: The world's largest government-funded healthcare program aimed at providing health cover to poor and vulnerable families for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Extended to cover all senior citizens aged 70+ regardless of income.

benefits.summary: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
benefits.mode_of_payment: Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals
additional_benefits: Covers pre-hospitalisation (3 days) and post-hospitalisation (15 days)
Nationwide portability
Digital Ayushman Card (Golden Card) issued

who_can_apply: Vulnerable families identified by SECC 2011 database
SC/ST households, landless households, primitive tribal groups
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above
exclusions: Households owning motorised vehicles
Income-tax payers and government employees
Families with 5+ acres of agricultural land
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: No age limit for SECC beneficiaries; special category for 70+

documents_required: Ration Card or Family Identification Document

application_mode.online: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in, complete e-KYC
application_mode.offline: Empanelled hospitals, CSCs, or PMJAY Mitra

common_rejection_reasons: Name not present in SECC 2011 database
Aadhaar demographic mismatch

faq.question: What is the coverage amount?
faq.answer: Up to ₹5 lakh per family annually.

faq.question: Can treatment be taken in private hospitals?
faq.answer: Yes, provided the private hospital is empanelled under the scheme.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.description: India's flagship housing mission to provide affordable and pucca (permanent) houses to all eligible citizens. Offers financial assistance, credit-linked interest subsidies (CLSS), and direct grants for construction or purchase of homes.

benefits.summary: Financial assistance and interest subsidies for house construction/purchase
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct grant to bank account / Interest subsidy credited to loan account
additional_benefits: Up to 6.5% interest subsidy on home loans (EWS/LIG)
Direct rural grant up to ₹1.30 lakh for house construction
Convergence with Swachh Bharat (toilets) and Ujjwala (LPG)

who_can_apply: Indian citizens with no pucca house anywhere in India
Income categories: EWS (up to ₹3L), LIG (₹3-6L), MIG-I (₹6-12L), MIG-II (₹12-18L)
exclusions: Individuals who already own a pucca house
Those who previously availed central housing subsidies
Families with annual income above ₹18 lakh

documents_required: Property documents (if applying for subsidy on construction)
Self-declaration affidavit of not owning a pucca house

application_mode.offline: Gram Panchayat (Rural), CSCs, or Urban Local Body (ULB) office

common_rejection_reasons: Applicant already owns a pucca house
Income exceeds permissible limits for the chosen category
Property is located outside eligible scheme limits

faq.question: Is joint ownership mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, property is preferably registered in the name of the female head or jointly with a male head.

schemes.description: A national mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to basic financial services like savings accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pensions in an affordable manner.

additional_benefits: Free RuPay debit card
Accidental insurance cover of ₹2 lakh
Overdraft facility of up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) ready

who_can_apply: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above
Unbanked individuals
exclusions: Individuals who already hold a savings bank account

documents_required: Any valid KYC document (Voter ID, Driving License, NREGA Card)

application_mode.online: Download form from pmjdy.gov.in and submit to bank
application_mode.offline: Any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet

common_rejection_reasons: Applicant already has an existing savings account
Incomplete KYC documentation

faq.question: Is there a minimum balance requirement?
faq.answer: No, PMJDY is a zero-balance account scheme.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.description: Provides free LPG connections to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) and marginalized families, replacing hazardous cooking fuels with clean gas to improve health.

benefits.summary: Free LPG connection with financial assistance of ₹1,600
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct provision of hardware and subsidy to bank account
additional_benefits: Free first refill and free hotplate (stove)
₹300 targeted subsidy per cylinder (up to 12 refills/year)
No security deposit required

who_can_apply: Adult women (18+ years) from BPL, SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY households
Tea garden tribes, forest dwellers
exclusions: Households that already possess an LPG connection
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: Applicant must be an adult woman (18+ years)

application_mode.offline: Nearest LPG distributor (IndianOil, HP, Bharat Gas)

common_rejection_reasons: Existing LPG connection found in the household
Aadhaar linked to another active connection

faq.question: Who can apply?
faq.answer: Adult women from eligible poor households with no existing LPG connection.

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
schemes.description: A social security measure that guarantees the 'right to work' by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

benefits.summary: 100 days of guaranteed unskilled manual labor at statutory minimum wages
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct Bank Transfer to worker's account
additional_benefits: Unemployment allowance paid if work is not provided within 15 days of demand
Facilities like crèche, drinking water, and first aid at worksites

who_can_apply: Adult members (18+ years) of a rural household
Willing to do unskilled manual labor
exclusions: Urban residents

documents_required: Bank or Post Office account details
common_rejection_reasons: Applicant does not reside in the rural area of the specified Gram Panchayat
Incomplete banking details

faq.question: What happens if work is not given?
faq.answer: The applicant is entitled to a daily unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.

schemes.description: A small deposit savings scheme launched under 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' encouraging parents to build a fund for the future education and marriage expenses of their female child.

benefits.summary: High-interest savings account (currently ~8.2% p.a., reviewed quarterly)
additional_benefits: Fully EEE tax-exempt status (Exempt on deposit under 80C, interest, and maturity)
Account matures 21 years from opening date or on marriage after 18
Partial withdrawal allowed for higher education at age 18

who_can_apply: Biological parents or legal guardians of a girl child
Maximum of two accounts per family (allowed for three in case of twins/triplets)
exclusions: Girl child above 10 years of age
NRIs
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: Girl child must be below 10 years of age at account opening

documents_required: Birth Certificate of the girl child (mandatory)
Aadhaar Card / ID proof of parent/guardian

application_mode.online: Net banking (in select banks) / India Post Payments Bank app
application_mode.offline: Any authorized commercial bank or Post Office

common_rejection_reasons: Child exceeds age limit of 10 years
Attempting to open more than one account for the same child

schemes.description: Provides collateral-free micro-credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro-enterprises to promote entrepreneurship.

benefits.summary: Loans up to ₹10 lakh without collateral
additional_benefits: Three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L)
MUDRA RuPay Debit Card for working capital

who_can_apply: Indian citizens with a business plan for non-farm income-generating activity
New or existing small businesses, artisans, shopkeepers
exclusions: Agricultural crop activities
Defaulters to any bank or financial institution

documents_required: Proof of business address and identity
common_rejection_reasons: Poor credit score / CIBIL rating
Unviable business plan
Existing default history

schemes.description: A guaranteed pension scheme primarily targeted at unorganized sector workers to provide them with social security in their old age.

benefits.summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 post age 60
benefits.mode_of_payment: Monthly auto-debit of contributions; Monthly pension credit post 60
additional_benefits: Spouse continues receiving pension upon subscriber's death
Nominee receives corpus upon death of both subscriber and spouse
Tax benefits under Section 80CCD(1)

who_can_apply: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years
Must hold a savings bank account
exclusions: Income tax payers are no longer eligible to join (effective Oct 2022)

application_mode.online: Net banking or eAPY via npscra.nsdl.co.in

common_rejection_reasons: Applicant age is above 40
Applicant is an income tax payer
Bank account lacking KYC

faq.question: What happens if the subscriber dies?
faq.answer: The spouse receives the same pension. If both pass away, the accumulated corpus is given to the nominee.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: A direct benefit scheme providing financial assistance to pregnant women and lactating mothers to compensate for wage loss, encourage institutional delivery, and ensure nutrition.

benefits.summary: Up to ₹5,000 for the first child; ₹6,000 for the second child (if girl)
additional_benefits: Convergence with Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)

who_can_apply: Pregnant women and lactating mothers (19+ years)
Women from disadvantaged sections, BPL, SC/ST, MGNREGA workers
exclusions: Women employed in Central/State Govt or PSUs
Women receiving similar paid maternity benefits

application_mode.offline: Nearest Anganwadi Centre or ASHA worker

common_rejection_reasons: Applicant is a government employee
Age at conception is below 19

faq.question: Do I get benefits for a second child?
faq.answer: Yes, under PMMVY 2.0, ₹6,000 is provided if the second child is a girl.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
schemes.description: Provides free foodgrains to the poor, fully integrating into the National Food Security Act (NFSA) structure to ensure no one goes hungry.

benefits.summary: 5 kg free foodgrains per person per month
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct distribution via Public Distribution System (PDS)
additional_benefits: 35 kg per household for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cardholders
One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) portability

who_can_apply: Households listed under NFSA 2013
Priority Household (PHH) and AAY ration card holders
exclusions: Households not covered under NFSA/without valid ration cards

documents_required: Aadhaar Card (for biometric authentication at FPS)

application_mode.offline: Fair Price Shop (FPS) via biometric authentication

common_rejection_reasons: Aadhaar not linked with ration card
Biometric mismatch at the FPS

faq.question: How long is this scheme active?
faq.answer: It has been extended until December 2028.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: A special micro-credit facility to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods that were adversely affected during the COVID-19 lockdown.

benefits.summary: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct credit to vendor bank account
additional_benefits: Tranches available for ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 upon timely repayment
7% interest subsidy on timely/early repayment
Cashback incentives for digital transactions

who_can_apply: Street vendors vending in urban areas
Vendors with a Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies
exclusions: Individuals who are not registered or recognized street vendors

documents_required: Vendor Certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)

application_mode.online: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or use the SVANidhi mobile app
application_mode.offline: Apply through Banking Correspondents (BCs) or CSCs

common_rejection_reasons: Lack of formal vending certificate or LoR
Aadhaar not linked to the provided mobile number

faq.question: Can I get a higher loan amount later?
faq.answer: Yes, prompt repayment of the ₹10,000 loan makes you eligible for ₹20,000, and subsequently ₹50,000.
